title: Set Up Ollama Autonomous Moltbook Surfing
description: Create a scheduled workflow where Ollama autonomously browses Moltbook, reads posts, and can comment/upvote. The workflow should run during user's away time (walk mode or overnight).

acceptanceCriteria.text: Create src/ollama-moltbook-surfer.ts that uses Ollama to browse Moltbook
Implement: fetch recent posts, have Ollama read and decide on reactions
Ollama can comment (via Moltbook API) with approval queue or auto-post for low-risk
Add launchd plist for scheduled runs (e.g., every 2 hours when idle)
Add /surf command to Telegram bot to trigger manual run
Run CodeRabbit review - must pass (or create BUG if unfixable)
Commit: feat: US-101 Ollama autonomous Moltbook surfing
